Always Logging Me Out. I’ve never had an app for my car before so I think it’s pretty handy. The app wants to be wonderfully convenient, but it is falling short. You can see the status of the car, if it’s locked or unlocked, or the windows open, your tire pressure, etc. but can’t do anything about it. Most frustrating thing for my vehicle which is a hybrid, is that if you have no hybrid battery power you cannot use the climate control feature on the app. I don’t know why every other car can do remote starts but my 2022 cannot. 

Most frustrating thing however is that the app is always logging me out and I am the only driver. Almost every other time that I open the app, it is asking me to sign in on the BMW USA website. This would be no problem, but the website has very specific password requirements and I just need to be better at remembering my password. Once I re-enter my credentials there, the app will open and I have to put my pin in. It would be really nice if I could open and access the app with my pin more reliably without having to go to the website to verify as frequently as I do.
